# notify



Notify ZSH module providing notification services for desktop and Telegram 



## Features

- Desktop notifications via notify-send
- Telegram notification integration via noti
- Adapter-based provider pattern for interchangeable backends
- Configurable notification channels






## Requirements

- zsh (loaded as part of dotfiles zsh modules)
